svg.title: Flow figure: Browser, API Server, Cache, Database. Steps: cache miss, cache hit.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Browser, API Server, Cache, Database. cache miss. The browser asks for user 42. The API server checks the cache first. The cache has no entry. The API server reads the row from the database. The API server stores the row in the cache and sends the response. cache hit. The browser asks for user 42 again. The cache has the entry now. The API server sends the response. The database gets no query.

g.text: The API server checks the cache first. The cache has no entry.
The API server reads the row from the database.
The API server stores the row in the cache and sends the response.
The browser asks for user 42 again.
The cache has the entry now.
The API server sends the response. The database gets no query.
